# `disk` check

Check usage and free space of the filesystem holding a path.

```yaml
checks:
  example:
    type: disk
    path: /
    expect:
      used: { warn: 85%, fail: 92% }
      free: { warn: 10GiB, fail: 2GiB }
```

## Keys

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` **(required)** | string |  | Any path on the filesystem to check, e.g. / or /var/lib/docker. |
| `expect` | mapping |  | What counts as healthy. |
| `expect.used` | {warn, fail} percent | `{warn: 85%, fail: 92%}` | Share of space in use. Triggers when the value is above the threshold. |
| `expect.free` | {warn, fail} size |  | Free space. Triggers when the value is below the threshold. |
| `expect.inodes_used` | {warn, fail} percent |  | Share of inodes in use. Triggers when the value is above the threshold. |

Every check also accepts the [common keys](../config.md#common-check-keys).

One-liner: `medic check disk <path> [--set key=value ...]`
